title: Teeth chart
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y1 lesson 5 (Teeth chart (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 5: Keeping clean: hands and teeth. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: What are germs?
points: They live on hands and in mouths

blocks.text: Colour a box each time. Brush for two minutes, morning and night.

keywords.def: tiny living things that can make us ill
a twig used to clean the teeth (مِسْوَاك)

questions.q: Show me the handwashing steps with your hands (no water).
questions.a: Wet, soap, rub backs, fingers and thumbs, rinse, dry.

questions.q: Say two times we wash our hands.
questions.a: Before eating and after the toilet (also after playing outside).

questions.q: Core: Go to a sink with a grown-up and wash your hands properly, counting to 20. Come back and give a thumbs up.
Extend: Draw a toothbrush and a miswak and colour them in (objects only).
questions.a: A labelled drawing of a toothbrush and a miswak.

questions.q: When must we wash our hands?
options: After playing a game on the sofa
questions.a: A) Before eating. Before eating (and after the toilet) stops germs getting into our mouths.

questions.q: Germs are... A) tiny and can make us ill B) big and friendly C) only on toys
questions.a: A) tiny and can make us ill
options: Tiny and can make us ill

questions.q: Big question: how do we get germs off our hands?
questions.a: Wash with soap and water for 20 seconds.
